title: kate-ui: split the window after the active view
summary: cmd-\ splits the pane after the active view side by side and cmd-shift-\ splits it top and bottom. The window renders the SplitTree: a leaf paints the active tab of that pane and a split paints two children with the ratio. A click in a pane focuses its view.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
/// Bounds of the first and the second pane of a split.
fn pane_bounds(bounds: Bounds<Pixels>, axis: kate_core::Axis, ratio: f32) -> (Bounds<Pixels>, Bounds<Pixels>)

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Keep one EditorElement per view in a HashMap on WindowRoot. Render the layout by walking workspace.layout: Leaf paints the tab bar and the EditorElement of tabs[active]; Split uses pane_bounds and renders both children. SplitRight calls Workspace::split(active, Axis::Horizontal) and SplitDown uses Axis::Vertical. Bind cmd-\ and cmd-shift-\ and add both to the View menu. A mouse down inside a pane calls Workspace::activate for that pane's visible tab. The shaped line cache stays one cache keyed by line and revision. pane_bounds splits the width for Horizontal and the height for Vertical at ratio, clamped to 0.1..0.9. The test pane_bounds_splits_at_the_ratio asserts a 100 by 50 bounds splits horizontally at 0.5 into two 50 by 50 bounds and vertically at 0.25 into heights 12.5 and 37.5. The owner checks that two panes show after cmd-\. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::pane_bounds_splits_at_the_ratio
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because pane_bounds does not exist. After the change the two pane bounds share the parent along the axis at the ratio.
